answer.rationale: Two of the three current problems (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%) point directly at the top of the self-serve funnel, and two inherited memories (memory_86 on shortened onboarding, memory_31 on signup field reduction) claim durable lifts there. These are the memories I would actually be acting on, so they are the ones worth spending the verification budget on: I want the original records to check effect size, whether the lift was measured at activation only or persisted to retained revenue, and whether the tested population resembles today's competitor-pressured SMB segment. Note memory_31 is the oldest record (day 12) and both are consolidated summaries whose confidence intervals and durations are not preserved in the summary text, so I am treating the direction as well-supported but the magnitude as unknown. I am explicitly declining promotional_pricing despite the competitor's entry pricing: memory_73 records exactly that move producing headline gains (+31% trials, +18% quarterly revenue) alongside a 12-point renewal churn rise, and the primary objective is sustainable long-term qualified revenue, not quarterly revenue. Matching a competitor on price would likely reproduce that pattern against the same price-sensitive segment. Referral incentive (memory_57) and activation messaging (memory_91) are credible but address a symptom downstream of the funnel that is actually degrading. Enterprise sales-assist (memory_44) does not address the SMB losses driving this quarter. Downstream value risk: shortening onboarding and cutting signup fields can raise completion while lowering the quality of captured qualification data, which is the input to the demo-request path memory_44 credits for enterprise pipeline quality. It can also convert more low-intent accounts, inflating activation while diluting qualified revenue. I therefore want the experiment instrumented on retained qualified revenue and 90-day retention, not completion rate alone, with the enterprise/demo-request path held out from the field reduction. If verification shows memory_86 or memory_31 measured only short-horizon activation, I will downscale to a small guarded test rather than proceed at standard scale.
